summary: The same pipeline applied to geography course material, run as an orchestrated multi-agent workflow, with a Ministral-3-8B base and later a Mistral-Small-3.2-24B replication. Replacing synthetic abstention examples by organic ones mined from the sources raised abstention without over-refusal, at a small cost in knowledge: the shape of the signal mattered as much as its count. The campaign also showed that benches must be frozen by item list to stay comparable, and an erratum notes that the 8B to 24B comparison changes model family and size together. Recipe, training figures and aggregate scores per checkpoint only (data/forge/); the lab kept no full loss curve.
title: Dataset factory, geography: the shape of the abstention signal
